{{Top|leg}}
'''Daveed''' was an individual who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Daveed worked as a camera operator for a show on which the reporter [[Yara Grugara]] worked. On one occasion, the show's producers sent Daveed to film Grugara with a new camera. However, the camera did not capture the reporter's natural skintone and instead, made it look orange.<ref name="Cause of the Month">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040819|text=Cause of the Month}}</ref>
